  • Constructor Details

    • BoundaryResult

      BoundaryResult(WaterPhaseBoundaryResult.Status status, double temperatureC, double residual, double waterActivity, String diagnostic, String phaseReference)
      Creates one boundary outcome; unavailable temperatures are always NaN.
      Parameters:
      status - calculation status
      temperatureC - calculated temperature in Celsius
      residual - dimensionless equilibrium residual
      waterActivity - fluid-water fugacity divided by pure CPA-liquid-water fugacity
      diagnostic - calculation or failure explanation
      phaseReference - material phases and condensed reference used
